data_required: Official source semantics and provenance for match_playing_xi.csv
minimum_fields: Source URL/archive ID, extraction timestamp, license, row meaning, team/player ID dictionary, official status
unblocks: Interpret roster membership and trace data lineage
acceptance_check: Source owner confirms whether rows mean announced XI, squad, replacements, substitutes, or other; reproduce joins.

minimum_fields: Match/innings/decision timestamp, team, player_id, available status, announced XI status, substitute/replacement/withdrawal event and effective time
unblocks: Candidate membership and availability at each simulated decision
acceptance_check: Independent source with complete timestamped events and auditable coverage.

data_required: Bowling rules and candidate quota state
minimum_fields: Format/ruleset/version, scheduled balls per over, quota, candidate overs already bowled, penalties/restrictions, innings state
unblocks: Whether a candidate was legally permitted to bowl
acceptance_check: Recompute remaining quota using only pre-decision events; validate seven metadata anomalies.

data_required: Decision log or prospective shadow decision snapshots
minimum_fields: Exact decision time/index, complete eligible candidates, batter/context, current state, CRIC version/input, full ranked output, actual selection
unblocks: Auditable decision unit and prospective shadow evaluation
acceptance_check: Immutable append-only logs, versioned schema, missingness monitoring, no post-decision fields.

minimum_fields: Outcome horizon, extras/wicket rules, incomplete-horizon policy, primary descriptive or ranking question, minimum sample, split and metrics
acceptance_check: Review and freeze before inspecting holdout outputs; causal claims require separate design.

minimum_fields: Stable player ID, dated role/source, name/ID crosswalk, validity period
unblocks: Role-specific candidate criteria and resolution of identity anomalies
acceptance_check: Documented source, no role inferred from whether the player bowled.
